messages:
sam: quick heads-up — seeing structured tool args fail intermittently on AWQ int8 run. sample output invalid JSON from model, even though fp16 baseline is fine.
jess: hmm, are these from the same prompt set as the bakeoff? can you paste example?
sam: yes. repro prompt id p-4123. output snippet: ```{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"price range","filters":null,}}``` trailing comma, null vs {}. sometimes args are array not object.
arjun: can you run the roundtrip serializer locally? we had a hypothesis that KV cache reorder + quant noise causes missing commas? :thinking: 
sam: ran a quick fuzz harness that mutates toolargs keys and unicode. command: `pytest tests/fuzz/test_tool_args_roundtrip.py::test_awq_roundtrip -k p4123 -q` output attached below.
maria: results?
sam: summary: AWQ-int8: 1.8% invalid JSON across 5k samples; GPTQ-int8: 0.6%; fp8 sim: 0.4%; fp16 baseline: 0.05%. Invalid types: repeated keys, trailing commas, bare single quotes, unescaped control chars. failure modes concentrated at longer toolarg arrays (>6 items) and nested lists.
lina: interesting. what's the distribution by sequence length?
sam: invalids spike when seq_len > 1024 tokens, and when we force sample temp 0.7-1.2. beam vs greedy: sampling increases failures.
jess: does the console log show partial tokens being emitted? any streaming cutoff?
sam: in some cases streaming produced ```{"tool":"x","args":``` then generator stopped with no closing bracket. looks like early stop / EOS prediction. maybe quantized model overestimates EOS probability in some contexts.
arjun: could be tokenization boundary shift after quantization. try decoupling serialization tokens: surround JSON payload with markers "<JSON_START>" "<JSON_END>" and do strict post-parse. any diff?
sam: tried markers — reduced malformed by ~65% for AWQ-int8 but increased latency for token count. Also masked out special tokens in tokenizer fixed a subset.
maria: what's the action item? rollback AWQ for prod?
jess: don't rush. we should add roundtrip fuzz tests to CI and gate deploys if structured tool outputs exceed X% invalid. propose threshold 0.5% on 10k evals.
lina: +1. also add a small prompt engineering mitigation: explicit schema and use function-calling wrapper when available.
arjun: can someone file an eng-ml ticket with dataset, seeds, quant checkpoints, and attach failing samples? I'll start bisecting between AWQ and GPTQ.
sam: filing now. ticket: INF-4823. included seeds and harness. linking sample: https://internal.redwood/infr/tickets/INF-4823
ci-bot: fuzz-suite (AWQ-int8) started job 9812 — will post artifacts when done.
sam: thanks — will follow up with a short doc summarizing mitigations.
